publications.name: Joker: Joint Optimization Framework for Lightweight Kernel Machines
publications.description: A general nonlinear machine learning framework for large-scale data via joint optimization of lightweight kernel machines.
highlights: Processes 10M data points using only 10 GB GPU memory on a consumer-grade GPU.

publications.name: NPSVC++: A Representation Learning Framework for Nonparallel Classifiers
publications.description: A Pareto-optimal feature extraction framework for nonparallel support vector machine classifiers.
highlights: Improves accuracy by ~1.5% over traditional cross-entropy-based approaches.

publications.name: Learning the Optimal Discriminant SVM with Feature Extraction
publications.description: An adaptive joint learning model for feature extraction and classification.
highlights: Complete convergence theory analysis and an engineering-efficient implementation.

publications.name: LighTwSVM: Efficient Linear Nonparallel Classifier for Millions of Data
publications.description: An efficient linear nonparallel support vector machine for million-scale datasets.
highlights: Reduces memory and time usage by 50% compared with sklearn.svm.LinearSVC.

publications.name: Robust Twin Bounded Support Vector Classifier with Manifold Regularization
publications.description: A nonparallel SVM based on a nonconvex robust metric and manifold structure.
highlights: Significantly reduces the effect of data noise; global convergence is proven.
